instructions: Copy this EMPTY template into restricted-access storage OUTSIDE the deployed website root. Do not edit the template itself with staff names, evidence or approval dates.
Content Owner verifies facts, proposed department ownership and submits the exact page for review; record contentOwnerSubmittedBy and contentOwnerSubmittedAt.

Appropriate clinical, operational or institutional reviewer examines the actual page content, signs the review and records reviewerSignedBy, reviewerSignedAt and reviewedBy as an accurate attribution; lastReviewed MUST equal reviewerSignedAt.
Practice approver records real approvedBy, approvedAt and approvalReference. Set nextReview as the approved next review due date, never an automated interval.
Create reviewedContentSha256 with the --fingerprint command for the exact approved page after all editorial changes. Retain internal evidenceReference in restricted storage.
Only approved entries are exposed after cms/tools/build_clinical_governance.py --approvals /secure/path/approvals.json --build; deploy only governance-published.js.
When a review becomes due or content changes materially, move the secure record to review_due or in_review and regenerate; no approval banner will be displayed.

fieldGuide.path: Existing review-eligible page path, e.g. services/womens-health.html
fieldGuide.reviewedBy: Genuine reviewer attribution approved for public display; only say Woolloongabba Medical Centre Clinical Team when that team actually reviewed it
fieldGuide.lastReviewed: Actual date of clinical or governance review, YYYY-MM-DD
fieldGuide.nextReview: Actual approved Next Review Due, YYYY-MM-DD (later than final approval)
fieldGuide.contentOwner: Approved accountable department, not a guessed default
fieldGuide.approvalReference: Traceable meeting/sign-off ticket or document reference (PRIVATE)
fieldGuide.reviewType: Must match the eligible page reviewType (clinical, operational or institutional)
fieldGuide.contentOwnerSubmittedBy: Real content owner staff name; never a placeholder (PRIVATE)
fieldGuide.contentOwnerSubmittedAt: Actual owner handover date in YYYY-MM-DD (PRIVATE)
fieldGuide.reviewerSignedBy: Real staff member who completed the relevant clinical/operational/institutional review (PRIVATE)
fieldGuide.reviewerSignedAt: Actual review signoff date, YYYY-MM-DD; must equal lastReviewed (PRIVATE)
